enrichment_method.evidence: To deplete tryptic peptides, the remaining sample was incubated overnight with 50mM sodium cyanoborohydride and HPG-ALD (https://ubc.flintbox.com/technologies/888fc51c-36c0-40dc-a5c9-0f176ba68293) polymer at 1:4 peptide: polymer (w/w).

The notable differences were starting with 20 μg of proteome digested with activated MMP9, the use of using 60 mM formaldehyde and 50 mM sodium cyanoborohydride instead of TMTpro to label protein termini and lysines, and the depletion of tryptic peptides with undecanal instead of the HPG-ALD polymer.

labeling.evidence: TMTpro reagents (ThermoFisher Scientific, cat. no. A52045) were used to label protein termini and lysines in each sample at 1:4 protein: label (w/w) ratio.

The same settings were also applied to the MMP9 dataset, with the exception of dimethylation (+28.031) modification in place of TMTpro labeling, and quantification based on MS1 precursor signal with the Minora Feature Detector and the Precursor Ions Quantifier nodes.
